text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Unicorn Stakes.<n>Shinko Windy is
the focus of much<n>attention due to the biting
incident, and<n>many of the spectators are mocking
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to retaliate and bite them,<n>too, but
refrains after remembering<n>her promise. Instead,
she heads out<n>to compete, funneling her frustration
into motivation.
